name: Ink and wash
one_line: Black brush strokes and grey mist on warm paper, with one red.
look_words: Brush and ink on warm off-white paper. Three values only: paper, grey wash and black. Mountains, trees and rocks are soft grey washes that fade into mist in layers; the nearest things are the darkest. Empty paper is most of the picture and counts as sky, water and fog. Shapes are simple silhouettes with a dry-brush edge. One red, vermilion, is kept for harm and the final blow; a mineral green and a clear blue, used in small touches, mark what the player is after. The player is the blackest, sharpest shape on screen. Light is flat. Motion is like a stroke: quick, then still, with ink splashes for hits. Avoid colour fills, glow, bloom, hard digital lines and clutter.

palette.name: ink and wash
palette.notes: Paper, wash and black do almost everything. Red means harm and nothing else. Heavy fog is the look: far things should melt into the paper.

look_wish: ink outlines and grey wash on paper

upgrade.why: pen and brush lines that wobble like a hand drew them, with a paper grain

music.mood: sparse, bamboo flute and a single plucked string
music.notes: Long silences are part of it.

sound_feel: a brush on paper, wind, one wooden knock, water drops

frames.prompt: Ink and wash illustration on warm off-white paper, wide side view like a 2D adventure: a small figure in a wide straw hat poles a narrow boat across a misty lake toward a tiny pavilion on stilts, reeds in the foreground, two herons, far mountains as pale grey washes fading into empty paper. Black brush strokes, soft grey washes, dry-brush texture, lots of empty paper, one small vermilion-red lantern on the boat as the only colour. No seals, stamps or writing. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.

Black brush strokes, soft grey washes, lots of empty paper, dry-brush texture, only one red accent. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.
